name: Hinaori Kagome
source:
Role: Witch

Kagome is the "partner" of [url=/c1435]Akihito[/url] and his self-proclaimed "deredere osananajimi." Her top priority is the safety of her childhood friend. People call her the black witch because she’s a genius and doesn’t act like a normal person. She’s also selfish and does what she wants. She throws sarcasm and scorn towards everyone, especially Akihito. She lives two apartments away from Akihito and goes to his house through the window.

[spoiler]She is the most powerful connector. Her avatar is Sting.[/spoiler]
